title: Product Incomplete Scope
description: Part of a product discovery response that a seller could not complete. A product list never contains proposals.

enumDescriptions.products: Not all inventory sources were searched.
enumDescriptions.pricing: Products were returned, but pricing is absent or unconfirmed.
enumDescriptions.forecast: Products were returned, but forecast data is absent.
enumDescriptions.wholesale_feed: In wholesale mode, full feed enumeration could not complete in the time budget.
